name: Rhys ap Gruffydd
bio: Rhys's journey in motorsport began in the valleys of South Wales, tinkering with engines in his father's garage. His early exposure to engineering principles fueled a passion that led him to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering. After graduation, he joined a small karting team, quickly rising through the ranks from mechanic to team manager. He has a knack for optimizing resources and streamlining operations, always seeking marginal gains to boost performance. Rhys is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to motivate the team to achieve ambitious goals. His belief is that a well-oiled machine off the track translates to success on it.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the left side, with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Rhys is of average height, with a sturdy build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a cup of strong Welsh tea before every race.
